stations.title: Load capsule bodies
stations.does: Places empty aluminium capsule bodies into the filling/tamping positions.
steps: Verify station has available empty capsules
Index next capsule positions into filling/tamping queue
Place/seat empty capsule body into each position

stations.title: Weigh + fill (groups of 6)
stations.does: Dispense ground coffee by weight into capsules, filled in groups of 6.
steps: Index the next group-of-6 capsule bodies under the filler heads
For each cavity: weigh coffee dose then dispense into capsule
Wait for dispense complete per head
Hold capsules at fill position for tamp handoff

stations.title: Tamp filled coffee
stations.does: Tamp the filled coffee to the required compaction before sealing.
steps: Index the filled capsule group under tamping plungers
Lower tamp plunger into each capsule to set depth
Dwell to achieve compaction
Retract plungers and release to seal queue

stations.title: Seal foil lid
stations.does: Seal a foil lid onto each capsule using a sealing head.
steps: Index next group under sealing head
Pick and position foil lid onto each capsule rim
Seal: clamp then heat/press to form seal
Release sealing head and allow capsules to cool momentarily

stations.title: Camera seal inspection
stations.does: Use a camera to check every sealed lid for seal correctness.
steps: Index capsule to camera inspection point
Capture image(s) of lid seal area
Run vision check for seal correctness
Store verdict (pass/reject) for routing

stations.title: Reject bad seals
stations.does: Divert capsules with a bad seal to a reject path instead of sending them to packing.
steps: Read stored verdict for the current capsule
If PASS: keep capsule on main flow
If REJECT: actuate diversion (side pusher/cross transfer) to move capsule to reject bin
Update reject counter

stations.title: Pack into boxes of ten
stations.does: Pack passing capsules into boxes containing 10 capsules each.
steps: Accumulate passing capsules into a 10-count hopper/box form position
For each passing capsule: place into the current box until count reaches 10
When count == 10: close box-insert stage (box is pre-erected)
Advance filled box to boxing exit position and reset counter

notes: Food-grade hygienic design is required (washdown-safe materials, sealed enclosures at filler/seal zones, cleanability between changeovers).

The line is budgeted to 1.0 s per finished capsule at each station; the fill/tamp/seal operations are assumed to run in a synchronized group-of-6 cycle with indexing so the average throughput still meets 3600/hour.
Foil lids are assumed pre-fed to ST4; no foil web forming is included.

Packing ‘10 per box’ is implemented as count-and-fill with a continuously fed stream; box supply and any box closing are represented as machine actions, but the exact box type/mechanism is not specified in the brief—confirm.
